summary: The note describes lacrosse as a demonstration sport at the 1932 Summer Olympics in Los Angeles. Teams from Canada and the United States played three games, and the United States won the series 2 games to 1. The games were held in the new Los Angeles Memorial Coliseum before large crowds.
one_line: Overview of lacrosse as a demonstration sport at the 1932 Los Angeles Summer Olympics, where the United States beat Canada 2-1 in a three-game series.
key_facts: Lacrosse was a demonstration sport at the 1932 Summer Olympics in Los Angeles.
Teams from Canada and the United States played three games at the 1932 Summer Olympics lacrosse event.
The team from the United States won the lacrosse series 2 games to 1 over Canada.
The lacrosse games were played in the new Los Angeles Memorial Coliseum.
The games at the Los Angeles Memorial Coliseum were attended by large crowds.
